metrics.draft: NIST AI Risk Management Framework: Generative AI Profile (Zero Draft)
comment_themes: 1. Signed measurement as evidence primitive — every axis score should carry Ed25519 signature + Merkle inclusion proof
2. Anchored proof of when measurement was known — OpenTimestamps/Rekor as mandatory in high-risk profiles
3. Corrections ledger as structural requirement — published retraction history is the honesty primitive
4. Cross-organisational measurement verification — anyone can verify any signed card
5. Independence statement — measurement body must disclose all funding sources
6. Three-state verdicts (MEASURED / UNMEASURED / PENDING) instead of binary
metrics.submission_window: Wednesday Sep 16, same day as Arc genesis measurement

honest_sentence: NIST Zero Draft (GenAI Profile) closes Sep 16 (3 days). Six comment themes: signed evidence primitive, anchored proof of when known, corrections ledger requirement, three-state verdicts, independence disclosure, cross-organisational verification. Owner review needed.
